[LIMP.1.3] Library files are DS source files. They use the
same grammar as rule files. A `use` directive separates the two
([LDIA.2.10.1]), and a program imports libraries only ([LDIA.2.10.7]):
a library file declares schemas, services, consts, and
(rule-pack case) rules meant to be consumed by other files;
a rule file is the consumer.
